<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>This channel is intended as a guide for newer and returning players looking to jumpstart their way into RS3 PvM and Bossing.</nowiki></strong><nowiki> This page links to a host of pages, each dedicated to cover important subjects that help you on your PvM journey.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>General tips</nowiki></strong><nowiki> like setting up your game interface and basic money making to get started.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>New to PvM</nowiki></strong><nowiki> to get you to level 70 in every combat style! There are:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Example upgrade orders and ability bars</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guides on the important non-combat skills for PvM and some training methods</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Important quests to work towards</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>New to Bossing</nowiki></strong><nowiki> assumes you already have most of the PvM knowledge and skill from </nowiki><strong><nowiki>New to PvM</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and helps you set progression goals for bossing. This includes prayer flicking, good bosses for learning, how to learn PvM, and how to transition to full manual combat.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Note that the discord links in here will refer to either of two Runescape Discord servers. If you have not joined these, the links </nowiki><strong><nowiki>won't</nowiki></strong><nowiki> work.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The official Runescape Discord </nowiki>[https://discord.com/invite/rs <nowiki>invite link</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The PvM Encyclopedia </nowiki>[https://discord.gg/invite/pvme <nowiki>invite link</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-tips"><ins><nowiki>General Tips</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Before you begin, it can be helpful to get a few things out of the way:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Setting up a good interface - see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#interface-guide</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="help-and-guidance"><ins><nowiki>Help and Guidance</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If you ever feel stuck, confused, in need of teamforming, or wanting personal input on your PvM situation; there are several resources you can jump to.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Joining a Clan (RS discord recruitment page: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#RuneScape -&gt; looking-for-group</nowiki></span><nowiki>) or dedicated discord servers (PvMe Discord affiliates: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#affiliates</nowiki></span><nowiki>) can be great for getting (PvM) help or finding people to PvM with.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can ask Mentors in the RS Discord server for help </nowiki><span><nowiki>#affiliates</nowiki></span><nowiki> or look for groups in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#RuneScape -&gt; recruitment-all</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can ask for advice in the pvm-help channel of the PvMe Discord server for all your PvM inquiries! </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="skilling-goals"><ins><nowiki>Skilling Goals</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are many Skills in Runescape that are not direct combat skills, but that greatly impact your combat prowess through prayers, potions, perks, familiars, and relics. We covered these in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#noncombat-skilling-guide</nowiki></span><nowiki>. This page is relevant for </nowiki><strong><nowiki>New to PvM</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as well as </nowiki><strong><nowiki>New to Bossing</nowiki></strong><nowiki> readers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<h2 id="new-to-bossing"><ins><nowiki>New to Bossing</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This covers important level 70+ combat-related goals and upgrading information. You don't have to read all of this right away, there is a lot, just know it exists for when you feel you need a hand.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The go-to page that outlines mid to end-game quests, suggested monsters for training, handy items and more: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#mid-game-combat</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One such PvM lesson is prayer flicking: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#prayer-flicking</nowiki></span></p>
